POWER MECHANICS — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Management of Road Transport, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Management of Road Transport.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Management of Road Transport.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Management of Road Transport.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Management of Road Transport.

2. When learning Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.

   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker

5. When learning electronic systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

7. When learning Introduction to computer aided drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to computer aided drawing.

8. When learning Electrical Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)

   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

----
